messages:
maria: CI red on master after the toolchain bump (gcc14). Failing on macOS + linux shards. @leo can you take a look? https://ci.redwood/builds/54321
ci-bot: Build 54321 failed: /bazel-master/linux-x86_64 -- summary: link errors (see job)
leo: on it. quick skim of the logs shows a bunch of undefined refs at link time: libstdc++ symbols and __atomic* functions. looks like an ABI/symbol mismatch or rpath picking wrong libstdc++. :eyes:
jamal: if it's atomics it's often a gcc/libstdc++ mismatch. do we know what image infra rolled and when? @infra
maria: infra rolled images to gcc-14.0.1 yesterday ~02:05 UTC, no other infra changes landed on master since then.
leo: repro'd locally with the gcc14 image: `docker run --rm -v $PWD:/src -w /src gcc:14 /bin/bash -c "bazel build //..."` -> same link errors. snippet: ```
/usr/bin/ld: bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/third_party/fastmath/libfastmath.a(ops.o): in function `FastMath::AtomicAdd(long long*)':
ops.cpp:(.text._ZN8FastMath9AtomicAddEPx+0x18): undefined reference to `__atomic_fetch_add_8'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
jamal: can you try a quick bisect between gcc13/gcc14 images? if it reproduces on gcc13->gcc14 delta that'd be convincing.
leo: starting a fast bisect now: queuing two jobs to build the failing target on images pinned to gcc13 and gcc14. will post results in ~15m.
ci-bot: Rerun requested: Build 54322 queued by leo (fast-bisect jobs created)
maria: thanks. please add the failing test name and a minimal repro to the bug. if bisect shows regression we should either revert the toolchain roll or pin to gcc13 for the release CI. :thumbsup:
leo: minimal repro target is //third_party/fastmath:atomic_ops (small C++ file attached in the bug). sharing full link command in the bug for easier local reproduction.
jamal: if this is a libstdc++ symbol change we might need a rebuild of some prebuilt third_party libs or adjust link flags ( -latomic or adjust -Wl,--no-as-needed ). infra oncall should own the mitigation.
maria: creating tracking bug INFRA-3112 and assigning infra oncall. adding logs, minimal repro, and bisect output.
ci-bot: Bug INFRA-3112 created by maria (https://issues.redwood/INFRA-3112)
leo: will follow up with bisect results in thread. thanks all.
